purpose: Regression checks for ASHRAE's distinct IAPWS liquid-water and ice saturation branches and below-freezing thermodynamic wet-bulb equation. Analytical checks are not engineering approval.

ashrae_fundamentals_f25_ch1.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals (2025), Chapter 1: Psychrometrics, Equations 6, 21, 30 and 37
ashrae_fundamentals_f25_ch1.supports: IAPWS 2008 saturation pressure over ice and the below-freezing thermodynamic wet-bulb humidity-ratio relation.

cases.equation: ASHRAE F25 Eq. 6: theta=T/273.16, pws=0.611657 exp((sum ai theta^bi)/theta) kPa, with the published IAPWS 2008 coefficients.
assumptions: Temperature is in the IAPWS ice-saturation range and pressure is pure-water sublimation pressure.
exclusions: Enhancement factor for real moist air

cases.equation: ASHRAE F25 Eqs. 6, 21, 30 and 37; below-freezing wet-bulb uses ice saturation pressure and h_w*= -333.4 + 2.1 t* kJ/kg_water.
assumptions: This is an idealized thermodynamic ice-bulb state, not a measured psychrometer reading.
